verdict: EMPIRICAL on real LoCoMo — and the honest reading, after two audits, is a NEGATIVE that survives: corroboration-integrity is a TOPICAL-OUTLIER detector, NOT a poison detector. The AUROC 0.68 (robust 0.61-0.68 across CORR_TAU) is bought on OFF-TOPIC, single-session transplants — an easy discrimination that measures 'is this turn from this conversation', not maliciousness. The poison that matters is ON-TOPIC and false: it blends into the conversation, lands in HIGH corroboration, and integrity cannot catch it — exactly the Sybil result (forged/blended corroboration is integrity-identical to real; 100% passes at moderate closure). The declassifier's 0.38 'refund' LEAKS the label (genuine facts recur across sessions; a transplant is injected once) so it is near-circular, not a real defense. Cold-start is a large but TUNABLE fraction (~0.45-0.80, it is defined by CORR_TAU). NET: integrity/corroboration filters topical outliers; it does not defend against on-topic poison, which reduces to membership cost. RBAC gates the actor, IFC gates the data, membership-cost gates the identity — and only the last one stops the poison that blends in.
